description: Bulk-load files from a Snowflake stage into a table via COPY INTO -- mirrors Airflow's CopyFromExternalStageToSnowflakeOperator. One component instance, N COPY INTO assets: set loads: (a list of per-table overrides) instead of the single-instance asset_key/database/schema/table/stage fields. Supports partitions_def with {partition_key} substitution in stage_path, and replace_partition_column to DELETE the partition before COPY INTO so a re-run is idempotent.

asset_key.description: Dagster asset key (e.g. 'snowflake/loads/orders'). Required unless `loads:` is set (mutually exclusive with it).
asset_key.label: Asset Key

database.description: Target Snowflake database. Required unless `loads:` is set.
database.label: Database

loads.description: One component instance, N COPY INTO assets: a list of per-table overrides, each applied on top of this instance's own field values. Each item: {asset_key, table, stage_path, database?, schema?, stage?, file_format_options?, partition_type?, replace_partition_column?, ...}. Mutually exclusive with the top-level asset_key/database/schema/table/stage (single-instance mode).
loads.label: Loads

table.description: Target table name. Required unless `loads:` is set.
table.label: Table

stage.description: Stage to copy from, e.g. 'my_stage', '@my_stage', or '@~' for the user stage. The leading '@' is added automatically if omitted. Required unless `loads:` is set.
stage.label: Stage

account_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake account. Required unless resource_key is set.
account_env_var.label: Account Env Var

user_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake username. Required unless resource_key is set.
user_env_var.label: User Env Var

stage_path.label: Stage Path
stage_path.description: Subpath/prefix within the stage to copy from, e.g. '2026/01/'.

files.label: Files
files.description: Explicit list of filenames (relative to the stage) to load, rendered as FILES = ('a.csv', 'b.csv'). Leave unset to load every file matching `pattern` (or every file in the stage/path if `pattern` is also unset).

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.description: Regex pattern (Snowflake's PATTERN clause) to filter which staged files are loaded.

file_format_name.label: File Format Name
file_format_name.description: Name of an existing named file format object, rendered as FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = '...'). Set this or file_format_options, not both.

file_format_options.label: File Format Options
file_format_options.description: Inline file format options, e.g. {TYPE: CSV, FIELD_DELIMITER: '\|', SKIP_HEADER: 1}, rendered as FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' FIELD_DELIMITER = '\|' SKIP_HEADER = 1). Set this or file_format_name, not both.

on_error.label: On Error
on_error.description: COPY INTO's ON_ERROR option, e.g. 'CONTINUE', 'SKIP_FILE', 'ABORT_STATEMENT' (the default when unset).

purge.label: Purge
purge.description: If true, staged files are deleted after a successful load (COPY INTO's PURGE option).

force.label: Force
force.description: If true, files are reloaded even if already loaded previously (COPY INTO's FORCE option; by default Snowflake skips files it has already loaded).

match_by_column_name.label: Match By Column Name
match_by_column_name.description: For semi-structured formats: 'CASE_SENSITIVE', 'CASE_INSENSITIVE', or 'NONE' (the default when unset).

size_limit.label: Size Limit
size_limit.description: Maximum bytes loaded per COPY statement (COPY INTO's SIZE_LIMIT option).

truncatecolumns.label: Truncatecolumns
truncatecolumns.description: If true, string values exceeding a column's length are truncated rather than erroring.

validation_mode.label: Validation Mode
validation_mode.description: If set (e.g. 'RETURN_ERRORS', 'RETURN_10_ROWS'), validates the load without inserting data and returns the validation result instead.

private_key_path_env_var.label: Private Key Path Env Var
private_key_path_env_var.description: Env var with RSA private key path.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered SnowflakeResourceComponent (resources/snowflake_resource). When set, connection credentials are read from that resource at run time instead of the inline account_env_var/user_env_var/password_env_var/pat_env_var/private_key_path_env_var/warehouse_env_var/role_env_var fields.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name, e.g. warehouse concurrency limits). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Kill the wait and fail the run if the COPY INTO hasn't finished after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying Snowflake call may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed, and this does not cancel the query server-side); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.

replace_partition_column.label: Replace Partition Column
replace_partition_column.description: When set (and a partitions_def is configured), runs `DELETE FROM <table> WHERE <replace_partition_column> = '<partition_key>'` before the COPY INTO, so re-running a partition is idempotent instead of appending duplicate rows on top of a prior load.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying time-window partitions definition.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
